method: Built-in image_gen tool; no API/CLI fallback
note: Generated photographic imagery, not photographs of real locations. Scanned wood and rock materials are separately credited in sources.json.

assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: production 3D environment background texture, a true 360-degree equirectangular panorama with 2:1 aspect ratio, 3072 by 1536 if possible. Create a photographic traditional Japanese garden seen from a small clear moss and fine gravel clearing. A weathered stone lantern off to one side, natural lichen-covered rocks, carefully pruned Japanese black pines, soft maple foliage, a small still pond, old bamboo fencing partially hidden by foliage, distant Japanese garden wall. All architectural objects and trees are at least 6 metres from the camera. Camera optical center 0.6 metres above the ground, horizon exactly at vertical midpoint, full spherical 360x180 projection including sky at top and moss/gravel nadir at bottom, left and right edges match seamlessly. Overcast bright soft natural daylight, restrained realistic greens, realistic intricate tiny leaf detail, believable photographic roughness and contact shadows. This must look like a high-quality photograph, not a render, illustration, game, miniature or diorama. No people, no furniture, no Go board, no text, no watermarks. Central foreground clearing is empty so a 3D board can be placed there.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: spherical 360-degree equirectangular environment panorama texture for a 3D application. 2:1 aspect ratio, ideally 3072x1536. Photograph taken beneath a very large mature Japanese zelkova tree in a peaceful park in early autumn. Entire 360x180 degree panorama, level horizon exactly at the image midpoint, sky zenith at top and forest floor nadir bottom, left and right edge seamlessly join. Camera height 0.6 meters from ground. Broad spreading tree canopy overhead with finely detailed real green and amber leaves, a very thick deeply textured trunk roughly six metres behind the camera (near panorama left/right seam), distant woodland and softly lit shrubs all at least 6 metres away. A broad empty flat clearing with fine compacted brown earth, sparse autumn leaves, natural dappled sunlight and soft leaf shadows, ample clear foreground for a separate game board. Looks like a real full-frame landscape photograph with highly detailed organic textures, naturally imperfect vegetation, no oversaturation. No people, no chairs, no furniture, no game board, no stylized 3D or illustration, no text or watermark.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 360x180 spherical equirectangular panorama 2:1 aspect ratio texture for a real-time 3D environment, ideally 3072x1536. Ultra-realistic Apollo Hasselblad photograph on the surface of the Moon, shot from an optical center just 0.6 metres above the ground. True spherical projection with level horizon exactly at midpoint, whole sky above and lunar soil nadir below, left and right edges join. Empty flat lunar regolith clearing in all directions with only small scattered pebbles in foreground, low crater rims and distant rugged lunar hills at least 30 metres away. Deep black starless space, a small realistically photographed blue white Earth just above the horizon, smaller than 3 percent of image width. Hard natural sunlight from upper left, detailed gray dusty regolith, realistic tiny impact pits, black shadows, physically believable restrained photographic colors. No astronauts, spacecraft, footprints, flags, buildings, furniture, game boards, text or watermarks. It must look like an actual photograph, absolutely not illustration or a game render.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: spherical 360x180 degree equirectangular environment texture, 2:1 aspect ratio, ideally 3072x1536. A real natural limestone cave chamber photographed at night, camera optical center 0.6 metres above an empty level dry sandy stone floor. Entire spherical view including ceiling zenith and ground nadir, horizon at midpoint, left and right edges join seamlessly. The craggy limestone walls and low stalactite ceiling form a comfortable chamber around a clear central space with at least 4 metres of open floor in every direction. Complex realistic stone strata, tiny pits and fissures, natural irregular formations, subtle brown-gray rock coloration. Dim warm amber illumination comes from a small oil lamp just outside the camera frame on the right, with believable dark recesses, soft bounced warm light and deep shadows. There is no visible lamp in this image because the application supplies a separate 3D lamp. Detailed photographic realism, photographed with a real camera and natural noise, not a game, cartoon or stylized model. No people, no furniture, no board, no signs, text or watermarks. Enough subtle detail in the shadows to read the cave shape.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: square diffuse color texture for a curved 3D houseplant leaf mesh. An extremely close, perpendicular macro photograph of the surface of one dark green peace lily leaf. The leaf surface fills every pixel of the square, no outer leaf outline and absolutely no background visible. A slender central vein runs exactly vertically down the middle, with subtle realistic branching veins curving out toward the two sides, tiny naturally irregular leaf pores, restrained realistic variations between olive green and deep green. Even diffuse soft illumination, no cast shadows, no gloss hotspot, no water droplets. This is a real botanical photographic material, not an illustration or decorative leaf pattern, no text. Sharp detail, natural healthy leaf.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: a square wood end-grain diffuse color texture for the end face of a high-end solid kaya Go floor board. Input image is ONLY a reference for the exact warm golden yellow wood color, not the grain direction. Create a perpendicular macro photograph filling the entire square with finely planed true kaya end grain. Very closely spaced delicate natural growth-ring lines appear as shallow broadly curved almost parallel arcs running from left to right; slow-grown fine-grained premium timber, silky smooth waxed matte finish, subtle tiny wood pores. Match the reference image's golden-yellow hue and brightness closely. Even shadowless diffuse lighting with no specular highlight. No knots, no split cracks, no full circular tree rings or central pith, no frame or board edges, no grid, no objects, no text or logos. Entire image is the wood surface. Photographic realism, not a repeating drawn pattern.
